pytest_args: unreadable_git_index or lsof_diagnostic or rollback_waits or relative_previous or failed_rollback_accounting or interrupt

mutants.name: snap unreadable Git status accepted as clean
mutants.old:
SNAP_STATUS=$(git -C "$SNAP" status --porcelain 2>&1) || abort "cannot inspect snapshot $SNAP: $SNAP_STATUS"
[ -z "$SNAP_STATUS" ] || abort "snapshot $SNAP is dirty"

mutants.name: old unreadable Git status accepted as clean
mutants.old:
PREV_STATUS=$(git -C "$PREV_SNAP" status --porcelain 2>&1) || abort "cannot inspect previous runtime snapshot: $PREV_STATUS"
[ -z "$PREV_STATUS" ] || abort "previous runtime snapshot is dirty"
mutants.new: [ -z "$(git -C "$PREV_SNAP" status --porcelain)" ] || abort "previous runtime snapshot is dirty"

mutants.name: lsof error diagnostic accepted as an empty port
rollback starts before asynchronous unload finishes
mutants.old:
wait_for_unload rollback
  rollback_wait_rc=$?
  if [ "$rollback_wait_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "ROLLBACK_WAIT_FAILED rc=$rollback_wait_rc" >> "$LOG"
    return 1
  fi

mutants.name: relative previous link resolved against process cwd
failed rollback ledger falsely reports success
